physical_waveform.clocking: embedded clock; receiver CDR recovers the clock.

packet_waveform.segmentation: Message > MTU split into First/Middle/Last/Only packets sequenced by PSN.
packet_waveform.vl_multiplexing: Packets of different VLs interleave on the link per VL arbitration.

flow_control_waveform.rule: Flow Control Packets advertise cumulative credits per VL; the transmitter sends on a VL only with available credits.

link_state_transition_trigger_waveform.qp_RESET_to_INIT_to_RTR_to_RTS: verbs Modify-QP brings the QP up before data transfer.

reliable_delivery_waveform.psn: Each reliable packet carries an increasing 24-bit PSN.
reliable_delivery_waveform.ack_nak: Receiver returns ACK up to a PSN, or NAK (PSN-seq / RNR / remote-access) carried in the AETH.
reliable_delivery_waveform.retransmit: Sender retransmits from the first un-ACKed PSN.

general_timing_rule: Bit timing is set by the per-lane signaling rate (e.g. 400 ps UI at 2.5 Gbps SDR, 100 ps at 10 Gbps QDR, 40 ps at 25 Gbps EDR). The Link Layer (VL arbitration, credits, VCRC) and Transport Layer (PSN ACK/NAK) run at the internal device clock, decoupled from the per-lane UI.
